lunch_time.name: Me
lunch_time.text: *Morning classes are over. Finally, lunch. Students pour out of the classroom.*

lunch_time_2.name: Me
lunch_time_2.text: *Lunchtime. The sound of a ball being kicked already echoes from the field outside. What should I do?*
choices: Ask Seoyeon to have lunch together.
Wander the school alone and find a quiet spot.
Follow the sound of volleyballs coming from the gym.
Head to the nurse's office — not feeling great.
Go to the school store and buy some bread.
Too tired. Take a nap in the classroom.

lunch_seoyeon_high.name: Seoyeon
lunch_seoyeon_high.text: *Her eyes light up the moment she sees me.* "{name}, I was just waiting for you. I've got a special spot to show you. Follow me."

lunch_seoyeon_low.name: Seoyeon
lunch_seoyeon_low.text: *She looks slightly awkward when she sees me.* "Oh, {name}... the teacher told me to look after you. Want to eat on the rooftop? It's quiet up there."

lunch_seoyeon_normal_branch.name: Seoyeon
lunch_seoyeon_normal_branch.text: *I walk over to Seoyeon. She gives a short smile and nods.*

lunch_seoyeon_2_study.name: Seoyeon
lunch_seoyeon_2_study.text: "Oh? The transfer student coming to me first — nice timing. Want to eat together on the rooftop? It's my secret hideout."
choices: Sure. I wanted to eat with you, Seoyeon.
Sorry, I kind of want to be alone today.
The rooftop? Honestly, sounds like a hassle.

lunch_seoyeon_2_party.name: Seoyeon
lunch_seoyeon_2_party.text: "Wow, adapting fast for a transfer student. Know about the secret rooftop spot? I've never shown it to anyone, but today you get a special invitation."
choices: Sure. I wanted to eat with you, Seoyeon.
Sorry, I kind of want to be alone today.
The rooftop? Honestly, sounds like a hassle.

lunch_seoyeon_2_normal.name: Seoyeon
lunch_seoyeon_2_normal.text: "Perfect timing. This is kind of my territory. I don't usually bring people here, but today's an exception. Want to eat together?"
choices: Sure. I wanted to eat with you, Seoyeon.
Sorry, I kind of want to be alone today.
The rooftop? Honestly, sounds like a hassle.

rooftop_1.name: Seoyeon
rooftop_1.text: *The rooftop, with a cool breeze sweeping through. Seoyeon pulls a carefully packed lunchbox out of her bag.*

rooftop_1_2.name: Seoyeon
rooftop_1_2.text: "I made it myself, and the portions are a bit much. It'd be kind of sad to have you surviving on store bread on your first day. Let's share."

rooftop_1_3.name: Me
rooftop_1_3.text: *I take a bite. It's full of care and flavor. Way better than I expected.*

rooftop_1_4.name: Me
rooftop_1_4.text: "Honestly, I'm surprised. This is really good. You actually made this yourself?"

rooftop_1_5.name: Seoyeon
rooftop_1_5.text: *Seoyeon lets out a pleased grin.* "Obviously. Cooking is one of the few hobbies I have. Eat up."

rooftop_talk_main.name: Me
rooftop_talk_main.text: *We eat the lunchbox together, chatting. The rooftop breeze is cool, and the atmosphere isn't bad at all.*

rooftop_1_2_2.name: Seoyeon
rooftop_1_2_2.text: "Nice to see you enjoying it — makes the effort worth it. Oh, try this one too. I put extra care into it."

rooftop_1_2_3.name: Seoyeon
rooftop_1_2_3.text: "Especially this octopus sausage — my masterpiece. Want to try it?"
choices: Whoa, you made this too? Seoyeon, you're surprisingly multi-talented.
Ahh... feed me.
I've never had a lunchbox like this. Genuinely, thank you.
Hmm... honestly the school store might've been better.

rooftop_talk_ah_fail.name: Seoyeon
rooftop_talk_ah_fail.text: *Seoyeon's expression goes rigid. She sets her chopsticks down and looks at me.* "...What? We're not at that level yet. Don't you think that's a bit much?"

rooftop_awkward.name: Me
rooftop_awkward.text: *The mood turned awkward fast. We ate in silence for a while after that.*

lunch_refuse_rooftop.name: Seoyeon
lunch_refuse_rooftop.text: *The corner of Seoyeon's mouth dips for a second. She recovers quickly, but a flash of disappointment showed through.* "...Alright. Got it. I'll go by myself then."

rooftop_talk_rude.name: Seoyeon
rooftop_talk_rude.text: *Seoyeon's hand freezes for just a moment. The expression drains from her face.*

rooftop_talk_food.name: Seoyeon
rooftop_talk_food.text: *She plays with her hair, trying to hide the smile tugging at her lips.*

rooftop_talk_food_2.name: Seoyeon
rooftop_talk_food_2.text: "Multi-talented... well, I won't deny it. Actually, this is the first time I've ever served my cooking to someone else. You're my inaugural taste-tester."

rooftop_talk_ah.name: Seoyeon
rooftop_talk_ah.text: *Seoyeon's face goes bright red. She hesitates, sighs like she's giving up... and picks up the chopsticks anyway.*

rooftop_talk_ah_2.name: Seoyeon
rooftop_talk_ah_2.text: "...You are seriously bold sometimes. (Pretending she can't be bothered, she picks up a sausage and brings it to my lips.) Just this once. Say ahh."

rooftop_talk_thanks.name: Seoyeon
rooftop_talk_thanks.text: *Seoyeon smiles briefly, then casually wipes a bit of sauce from the corner of my mouth with her finger.*

rooftop_talk_thanks_2.name: Seoyeon
rooftop_talk_thanks_2.text: "Don't thank me — I should be thanking you for eating with me. It definitely tastes better with company. Let's do this again sometime."

rooftop_2_normal.name: Seoyeon
rooftop_2_normal.text: *Finished eating, we sit side by side, feeling the breeze. Seoyeon breaks the quiet.*

rooftop_2_low.name: Seoyeon
rooftop_2_low.text: *After the meal, Seoyeon finally speaks after a heavy silence. There's a stiffness in her voice.*

rooftop_2_2_low.name: Seoyeon
rooftop_2_2_low.text: "{name}... honestly, talking with you today wasn't easy. But thanks for eating with me anyway."

rooftop_2_2.name: Seoyeon
rooftop_2_2.text: "{name}... I just met you today, but weirdly enough, conversation flows so easy. That's not normal for me. How about you?"

rooftop_free_talk.name: Seoyeon
rooftop_free_talk.text: "Was I being too serious? Let's just talk. Anything you want to ask me?"
rooftop_free_talk.context: Lunchtime on the school rooftop, just the two of them after sharing a lunchbox — a peaceful, slightly romantic atmosphere. Seoyeon is maintaining her cool demeanor but is starting to open up to the protagonist. Keep the conversation going until it wraps up naturally. When the conversation ends, Seoyeon will say being with the protagonist feels comfortable and ask why they think that is. Only in the final turn should she bring up this feeling of comfort or connection and pose the question.
rooftop_free_talk.personality: Cool-beauty student council president who's gradually becoming more honest around the protagonist. Blunt but slips in probing questions, opening up more or raising walls depending on the protagonist's responses.

rooftop_choices_high.name: Me
rooftop_choices_high.text: *Talking with Seoyeon, the mood has shifted to something subtle. She pushes hair from her face in the wind and stares at me. She said being with me feels comfortable and asked why I think that is.*
choices: Maybe it's something like fate?
Probably because you made it easy to be comfortable, Seoyeon.
Hmm, I'm not really sure yet.

rooftop_choices_low.name: Me
rooftop_choices_low.text: *Seoyeon's expression is complicated. The conversation hasn't exactly been smooth... and yet she said being with me feels strangely comfortable, and asked why I think that is.*
choices: Maybe it's something like fate?
Probably because you made it easy to be comfortable, Seoyeon.
Hmm, I'm not really sure yet.

rooftop_choices.name: Me
rooftop_choices.text: *A good conversation with Seoyeon wraps up. She watches me with a sparkle in her eyes, as if waiting. She said being with me feels comfortable and asked why I think that is.*
choices: Maybe it's something like fate?
Probably because you made it easy to be comfortable, Seoyeon.
Hmm, I'm not really sure yet.

rooftop_destiny_high.name: Seoyeon
rooftop_destiny_high.text: *Seoyeon draws a soft breath and rests her hand over mine. Her fingertips are warm.*

rooftop_destiny_high_2.name: Seoyeon
rooftop_destiny_high_2.text: "...I felt the same way. It's only day one, and here we are eating together like it's the most natural thing. Kind of strange, right? I want to keep doing this."

rooftop_destiny_normal.name: Seoyeon
rooftop_destiny_normal.text: *Seoyeon gently places her hand over mine. The wind tosses her hair around.*

rooftop_destiny_normal_2.name: Seoyeon
rooftop_destiny_normal_2.text: "Fate... that's a bit cheesy, but sure. Not bad. I get that feeling sometimes too."

rooftop_destiny_low.name: Seoyeon
rooftop_destiny_low.text: *Seoyeon quietly pulls her hand back and raises an eyebrow.*

rooftop_destiny_low_2.name: Seoyeon
rooftop_destiny_low_2.text: "Fate? Going big on day one, huh. {name}, don't you think that's a little fast? We're not really at that stage."

rooftop_kind_high.name: Seoyeon
rooftop_kind_high.text: *Her eyes widen in surprise, then melt into a gentle smile.*

rooftop_kind_high_2.name: Seoyeon
rooftop_kind_high_2.text: "Thanking me... if anything, I should be the one thanking you. You accepted my gesture so naturally — it made me feel at ease too."

rooftop_kind_low.name: Seoyeon
rooftop_kind_low.text: *Seoyeon lets out a sigh and looks away.*

rooftop_kind_low_2.name: Seoyeon
rooftop_kind_low_2.text: "Comfortable because I'm kind... that's kind of a low-effort answer, isn't it? Well, I guess being honest has its merits."

rooftop_kind_normal_2.name: Seoyeon
rooftop_kind_normal_2.text: "Model-student answer. But it's the right one. I'm glad I could make you feel comfortable."

rooftop_comfortable_high.name: Seoyeon
rooftop_comfortable_high.text: *Seoyeon, looking happy, leans her head lightly against my shoulder.*

rooftop_comfortable_high_2.name: Seoyeon
rooftop_comfortable_high_2.text: "Same here. When I'm with you, I feel like I can just be Seoyeon — not 'student council president Seoyeon.' Thanks for that."

rooftop_comfortable_low.name: Seoyeon
rooftop_comfortable_low.text: *Seoyeon smiles bitterly and looks up at the sky.*

rooftop_comfortable_low_2.name: Seoyeon
rooftop_comfortable_low_2.text: "You don't know... does that mean being around me is still awkward? Well, can't force it. Time will sort it out, I guess."

rooftop_comfortable_normal_2.name: Seoyeon
rooftop_comfortable_normal_2.text: "Comfortable — that's good to hear. I feel my unnecessary tension melt away when I'm with you too. I wish we had more moments like this."

seyoun_contact_exchange.name: Seoyeon
seyoun_contact_exchange.text: *Seoyeon pauses while packing her bag and looks at me.*
seyoun_contact_exchange.context: After sharing a lunchbox on the rooftop, the moment Seoyeon is about to suggest exchanging contact info. She wants to play it cool, but she's secretly a little nervous. A brief, casual exchange leading naturally into swapping numbers.
seyoun_contact_exchange.personality: Cool-beauty student council president. Direct and fact-driven, but bringing up contact exchange is one thing she can't quite pull off as smoothly as she'd like — a gap in her composure.

seyoun_contact_exchange_high.name: Seoyeon
seyoun_contact_exchange_high.text: *Seoyeon pulls out her phone, looking slightly bashful.* "Hey... let's exchange numbers. I might want to ask about lunchbox menus and stuff... you know, that kind of thing."
choices: Of course. I wanted to talk with you more anyway, Seoyeon.
Sorry, I think it's a bit too soon for that.

seyoun_contact_exchange_normal.name: Seoyeon
seyoun_contact_exchange_normal.text: "Mind if we swap numbers? Might need to reach you for student council stuff."
choices: Sure. I wanted to talk with you more anyway, Seoyeon.
Sorry, I think it's a bit too soon for that.

seyoun_contact_exchange_low.name: Seoyeon
seyoun_contact_exchange_low.text: *Seoyeon glances at me cautiously.* "...I might need to contact you for student council business, so could you give me your number?"
choices: Yeah, sure.
Sorry, I think it's a bit too soon for that.

seyoun_contact_success_cold.name: Seoyeon
seyoun_contact_success_cold.text: *She nods curtly as she saves the number.* "Thanks. I'll reach out when I need to."

seyoun_contact_success.name: Seoyeon
seyoun_contact_success.text: *She beams as she saves the number.* "Great. I'll text you later. You better reply, got it?"

seyoun_contact_fail.name: Seoyeon
seyoun_contact_fail.text: *The corner of Seoyeon's mouth drops for a second before snapping back up.* "...Yeah. Guess I was rushing it. We can take our time getting closer."

lunch_alone.name: Me
lunch_alone.text: *Walking the hallways alone, I end up at the library annex. My eyes meet those of a girl leaning by the window, reading a book.*

alone_2.text: *She lifts her gaze from the book and stares at me. Her voice is low and quiet.*

alone_2_2.text: "...If you're not going to be loud, you can sit."

yuna_intro.text: *Violet eyes study me in silence. The gaze of someone accustomed to observing.*

yuna_free_talk.name: Yuna
yuna_free_talk.context: The quiet library annex, meeting Yuna for the first time — a languid, does-things-at-her-own-pace girl. She's a person of few words who keeps things short, but says what she means. The type to write notes because talking is a bother, though she doesn't actually refuse conversation. Keep the dialogue going until it naturally concludes. When it ends, Yuna will ask whether the protagonist wants to know more about her or the school's secrets. Only in the final turn should she signal readiness to go deeper.
yuna_free_talk.personality: Languid, blunt literary girl. Would rather write notes than talk, but feels a strange pull toward the protagonist. Speaks in short, cryptic fragments. Completely at her own pace.

yuna_choices_high.name: Me
yuna_choices_high.text: *Talking with Yuna, I find myself drawn in by her peculiar atmosphere. She scribbled something on a blank piece of paper and slid it toward me. It reads: 'Want to know more?'*
choices: What do you mean this school isn't what it seems?
Familiar... have you seen me somewhere before?
You seem kind of dangerous. But I can't look away.

yuna_choices_low.name: Me
yuna_choices_low.text: *Yuna's gaze has gotten even colder. My attitude must not have sat well with her. She dropped a single icy remark.*
choices: What do you mean this school isn't what it seems?
Familiar... have you seen me somewhere before?
You seem kind of dangerous. But I can't look away.

yuna_choices.name: Me
yuna_choices.text: *The conversation with Yuna winds down for now. Those violet eyes are still watching me in quiet observation.*
choices: What do you mean this school isn't what it seems?
Familiar... have you seen me somewhere before?
You seem kind of dangerous. But I can't look away.

yuna_secret_high.name: Yuna
yuna_secret_high.text: *She taps the back of my hand with a fingertip and gives a cryptic smile.*

yuna_secret_high_2.name: Yuna
yuna_secret_high_2.text: "...So you're genuinely curious. I've been writing something lately. Haven't shown it to anyone yet. But for you... maybe I could."

yuna_secret_low.name: Yuna
yuna_secret_low.text: *She snorts and goes back to her book.*

yuna_secret_low_2.name: Yuna
yuna_secret_low_2.text: "Secrets? Way above your pay grade. Don't stick your nose where it doesn't belong."

yuna_secret_normal.name: Yuna
yuna_secret_normal.text: *A cryptic smile crosses her lips as she closes her book. She leans close to my ear and whispers.*

yuna_secret_normal_2.name: Yuna
yuna_secret_normal_2.text: "Curious? Sometimes not knowing is the real medicine. The things that look peaceful are the most dangerous."

yuna_scent_high.name: Yuna
yuna_scent_high.text: *She moves close and takes a slow, deep breath.*

yuna_scent_high_2.name: Yuna
yuna_scent_high_2.text: "...Unexpected reaction. Out of everyone who's wandered in here, none of them were like you. {name}, you're a bit different?"

yuna_scent_low.name: Yuna
yuna_scent_low.text: *She wrinkles her nose and turns her head away.*

yuna_scent_low_2.name: Yuna
yuna_scent_low_2.text: "Guess I was wrong. Nothing special. Don't act like you know me."

yuna_scent_normal.name: Yuna
yuna_scent_normal.text: *She takes a step closer and stares at me. She mutters with a wistful expression.*

yuna_scent_normal_2.name: Yuna
yuna_scent_normal_2.text: "First time meeting you. But you're kind of unusual. Most transfer students are too busy reading the room. You don't do that. Sort of interesting."

yuna_danger_high.name: Yuna
yuna_danger_high.text: *She gives a faint smile and lifts my chin with a finger.*

yuna_danger_high_2.name: Yuna
yuna_danger_high_2.text: "Dangerous? You're exaggerating. I just filter out annoyances fast. But you haven't been filtered out yet. Weird."

yuna_danger_low.name: Yuna
yuna_danger_low.text: *She fixes me with a frigid stare, a warning in her eyes.*

yuna_danger_low_2.name: Yuna
yuna_danger_low_2.text: "...Enough. Don't be exhausting. If you're not interested, go away."

yuna_danger_normal.name: Yuna
yuna_danger_normal.text: *Her cold fingers graze my cheek. An enigmatic smile.*

yuna_danger_normal_2.name: Yuna
yuna_danger_normal_2.text: "Dangerous... fun way to put it. Well, I was bored anyway. I'll keep you company for a chat."

lunch_store.name: Me
lunch_store.text: *Won the school store war and claimed the last chocolate conch bread! I take a triumphant bite of sweet victory.*

lunch_store_2.name: Me
lunch_store_2.text: *Happily munching my bread on the way back, I bump shoulders with someone.*

lunch_store_teacher.name: Teacher
lunch_store_teacher.text: "Oh, sorry— wait, {name}? You here for store bread too?"

lunch_store_teacher_2.name: Teacher
lunch_store_teacher_2.text: "That one's genuinely good. I came to get it myself but you beat me to it. Enjoy. ...Don't worry, I'm not the type of teacher who steals bread from students."

lunch_sleep.name: Me
lunch_sleep.text: *I slump over my desk to nap. Warm sunlight through the window heats my back.*

lunch_sleep_2.name: Me
lunch_sleep_2.text: *In my dream, someone called my name. A voice that felt achingly nostalgic and sad...*

lunch_sleep_3.name: Me
lunch_sleep_3.text: *I open my eyes to find someone staring straight down at my face.*

lunch_sleep_seoyeon_2.name: Seoyeon
lunch_sleep_seoyeon_2.text: "You were sleeping so soundly I almost didn't wake you... but if you're late, it reflects on me. See you after school."

lunch_dain.name: Me
lunch_dain.text: *The lively sound of volleyballs echoes from the gym direction. I follow the sound.*

lunch_dain_2.text: *I open the gym door to find a girl practicing volleyball alone, completely locked in. She spots me, breaks into a huge grin, and waves.*

lunch_dain_3_active.text: "Hey! I saw you during introductions! You had crazy energy! Don't just stand there watching — get over here! Let's go!"

lunch_dain_3_normal.text: "Hey! What are you doing just standing there! Get over here and play! You look like you've got some game!"

dain_name_share_2.name: Dain
dain_name_share_2.text: "{name}? Oh! I'm Dain, volleyball club! Nobody at this school can out-jump me! Try me if you dare!"

lunch_dain_gym_2.name: Dain
lunch_dain_gym_2.text: "Alright, this is our turf! {name}, how about a round? Doesn't matter if you're a beginner! Hey, your stamina's kind of weak for a transfer student, isn't it? You're gonna need to work out if you want to keep up with me!"
choices: Let's do this! Bring it on!
I don't really know volleyball... can you teach me?

lunch_dain_play.name: Dain
lunch_dain_play.text: "Oh! Love that energy! Here it comes! (Dain fires a powerful serve. I barely manage to return it.)"

lunch_dain_teach.name: Dain
lunch_dain_teach.text: "Hehe, don't be scared! I'll teach you everything from the ground up! Okay, posture first!"

lunch_dain_end.name: Me
lunch_dain_end.text: *I spent the entire lunch break sweating it out with Dain. Didn't expect my first day to be this high-energy. Before I knew it, afternoon classes were over too.*

lunch_nurse.name: Me
lunch_nurse.text: *Maybe it's first-day nerves, but I've got a slight headache. I quietly make my way to the nurse's office.*

lunch_nurse_2.text: "Oh my, a face I haven't seen before? I didn't know we had such a cute transfer student~"

nurse_intro.name: Nurse
nurse_intro.text: "I'm the school nurse. The kids just call me 'Nurse'... but for you, maybe I'll share my actual name?"

nurse_name_share_study.name: Nurse
nurse_name_share_study.text: "{name}... you've got really clear eyes. I saw your introduction earlier — total honor student vibes. Brain overheated from studying? Or just worn out from a stressful first day?"

nurse_name_share_normal.name: Nurse
nurse_name_share_normal.text: "{name}... you've got really clear eyes. Something hurting? Or just a little tense from your first day?"

nurse_free_talk_day1.name: Nurse
nurse_free_talk_day1.text: "Don't be nervous. You can relax here. Anything you want to ask, go ahead~"
nurse_free_talk_day1.context: First meeting with the school nurse in the nurse's office. The nurse has a playful, teasing manner, calling the protagonist 'cute transfer student' to mess with them. Keep the conversation going until it naturally wraps up. When it ends, lunchtime is over and the scene transitions to after school. Only in the final turn should the nurse mention it's time for class and send the protagonist off.
nurse_free_talk_day1.personality: Playful, teasing school nurse. Enjoys calling the student 'cute transfer student' and subtly poking fun, but underneath genuinely cares about and looks out for them. Perceptive and gentle beneath the mischief.

nurse_day1_end_high.name: Me
nurse_day1_end_high.text: *Chatting with the nurse, time flew by until class. She told me to definitely come back and visit. Something tells me this place is going to keep pulling me back.*

nurse_day1_end_low.name: Me
nurse_day1_end_low.text: *The nurse's expression hardened. I must have taken my jokes too far. She didn't bother hiding her displeasure and told me to head back to class.*
